notes: The hub now runs your plugins instead of DungeonHelper doing it, and it takes them all over automatically. On startup every installed plugin is moved into the hub — including ones that aren't in the catalogue and other authors' plugins — so DungeonHelper is left with a single icon on its toolbar instead of one per plugin. Restart DungeonHelper once after updating and they'll all appear in the hub's sidebar, each with its own icon and its own page. New installs go straight into the hub too. Rebuilt interface: nav list on the left, the selected plugin's panel on the right, and an 'All plugins' page for installing, updating and moving plugins between the hub and DungeonHelper. Anything you'd rather DungeonHelper ran itself can be moved back out from there, and that choice sticks — it won't be pulled back in. Your settings travel with each plugin, and anything that fails to load is listed with the reason rather than silently disappearing.
